title: Publishing Policy
summary: Institutional assets require an identified owner, completed review, and explicit human authorization before release.
rules: Every publication must identify its source material.
Publication requires an explicit human decision.
The release record must preserve the approved version.

title: Disclosure Policy
summary: Claims must be traceable to the source and uncertainties must be disclosed.
rules: Do not present projections as verified outcomes.
Mark synthetic or illustrative data clearly.
Flag claims that lack direct source support.

title: Review Policy
summary: A specialist review must identify unsupported claims, ambiguity, and publication risks.
rules: Review findings must be recorded structurally.
Warnings may proceed only with human acknowledgement.

title: Asset Lifecycle
summary: Institutional Assets move through draft, review, authorized, released, superseded, or archived states.
rules: Every material change creates a new version.

title: Product Positioning
summary: Product communications should state the audience, problem, capability, evidence, and limitations.
rules: Separate current capability from roadmap intent.
Use language appropriate for an institutional audience.
